name: Whirlwind Smite
body:
School evocation; Level antipaladin 2, paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Effect one attack per threatened enemy
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

This spell allows you to strike multiple foes with a single smite attack. When you cast this spell you also expend a use of your smite class ability and make an attack roll against each enemy in your threatened area. Each attack gains any bonuses from your smite.
